findings.desc: M6 parity report does not exercise the actual optimized runtime path. CHK-004 promises reference full-scan, indexed runtime, and cached runtime gold queries, but runPlaybookRuntimeOptimizedParityReport reads records.jsonl and calls local report helpers instead: runIndexedColdScan still iterates every raw record and computes a local shortlist (packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-baseline.ts:1119), while runIndexedWarmCache only returns a digest from a new one-entry Map (packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-baseline.ts:1150). That path never drives buildMemoryFreshnessPack through RuntimeMemoryIndex/selectRuntimeMemoryIndexCandidates or the M3 cache get/remember boundary (packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-memory.ts:623, packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-memory-cache.ts:336, packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-memory-cache.ts:381), so the actual M3/M4 consumer index/cache could regress while the million parity report stays green. The M6 evidence should either run the real optimized runtime pack/cache path at the million-record boundary or downgrade the claim so it is not used as proof of indexed/cached runtime parity.

M6 optimized parity report does not exercise the optimized runtime path it claims to validate. Evidence: packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-baseline.ts:1099-1181 builds reference/indexed/warm digests by scanning recordsRaw with local shortlist helpers and a one-entry Map cache; it never calls buildMemoryFreshnessPack, rebuildRuntimeMemoryIndex, selectRuntimeMemoryIndexCandidates, getRuntimeMemoryPackCacheHit, or rememberRuntimeMemoryPackCache. packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-m3-m6-smoke.ts:334-342 only asserts those synthetic digests are equal, so the smoke can pass even if the real runtime index/cache path regresses. Commands observed: npm --prefix packages/main run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-m3-m6-smoke.js passed with referenceFullScanMs=19986 indexedColdMs=20817; node packages/main/dist/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-baseline-smoke.js passed.

M4 coverage is incomplete: the lifecycle consumer smoke enumerates session_brief, host_handoff, story_create, done_prepare, done_closure, and final_response_check, but omits the story_advance consumer even though transition-orchestrator renders memory with consumer='story_advance'. This leaves the checklist's story_advance optimized/advisory-only consumer promise untested. Source refs: packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-m3-m6-smoke.ts:255, packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:291.

M6 million-record parity does not prove the real optimized runtime index/cache path: the full-profile smoke calls runPlaybookRuntimeOptimizedParityReport, whose indexedCold branch is a local recordsRaw shortlist scan and whose warm cache is a one-entry Map of the prior digest. It never drives buildMemoryFreshnessPack/rebuildRuntimeMemoryIndex/getRuntimeMemoryPackCacheHit on the 1,000,000-record corpus, so cache/runtime parity can pass while the shipped optimized runtime path is broken at scale. Source refs: packages/main/src/tasks/playbook-runtime-memory-m3-m6-smoke.ts:334, packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-baseline.ts:1119, packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-baseline.ts:1150, packages/main/src/core/playbook-runtime-baseline.ts:1177.
